parameters.command: echo "OS|$(lsb_release -ds 2>/dev/null)"; echo "PG|$(sudo -u postgres psql -d n8n -tAc 'show server_version' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"; sudo -u postgres psql -d n8n -tAc "select 'DB|'||datname from pg_database where not datistemplate and datname<>'postgres'" 2>/dev/null; echo "N8N|$(docker exec n8n n8n --version 2>/dev/null)"; echo "NODE|$(node -v 2>/dev/null)"; echo "CADDY|$(caddy version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"; awk '/^[a-zA-Z].*\{/{h=$1} /reverse_proxy/{print "ROUTE|"h"|"$2}' /etc/caddy/Caddyfile 2>/dev/null

echo "OS|$(lsb_release -ds 2>/dev/null)"; echo "PG|$(sudo -u postgres psql -d n8n -tAc 'show server_version' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"; sudo -u postgres psql -d n8n -tAc "select 'DB|'||datname from pg_database where not datistemplate and datname<>'postgres'" 2>/dev/null; echo "N8N|$(docker exec n8n n8n --version 2>/dev/null)"; echo "NODE|$(node -v 2>/dev/null)"; echo "CADDY|$(caddy version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"; awk '/^[a-zA-Z].*\{/{h=$1} /reverse_proxy/{print "ROUTE|"h"|"$2}' /etc/caddy/Caddyfile 2>/dev/null
